title: All Channels
description: Not every event uses the same channels — booking a shipment only sends an email, but a shipment being delivered sends both an email and an SMS. Map out which events produce which channels rather than assuming they're all the same.
successCondition: After booking a shipment, the outbox contains exactly one new message for that customer: an "email". After advancing that same shipment through tracking until its status becomes "delivered", the outbox additionally contains both a new "email" and a new "sms" message for that customer — booking never produces an sms, only delivery does.
hints: POST /api/tracking/:id/advance (dispatcher/admin) can be called repeatedly to walk a shipment to "delivered" without waiting for the real-time feed.
Filter the outbox by channel as well as recipient to avoid conflating the booking email with the delivery email.
